title: Glyconian
summary: GLYCO'NIAN GLYCON'IC, adjective [Low Latin glyconium.] Denoting a kind of verse in Greek and Latin poetry, consisting of three feet, a spondee, a choriamb, and a pyrrhic; as Glyconic measure.
